1 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.SmallPolyhedronCurvature
2 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.CutTreeAngleAccounting
3 
4 /-! Transfer actual original-vertex curvature to the cut tree.
5 The source is absent; every other original vertex occurs exactly once. -/
6 
7 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron.CutLocusTree
8 
9 open Set Real
10 
11 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} [Fintype P.Face]
12   {a : frontier P.body} (T : P.CutLocusTree a)
13 
14 /-- Original curvature on tree vertices, with zero at subdivision vertices. -/
15 noncomputable def originalCurvature (u : T.vertices) : ℝ :=
16   ∑ v : P.Vertex, if (v : Space) = (u : Space) then P.vertexCurvature v else 0
17 
18 theorem originalCurvature_at_vertex (u : T.vertices) (v : P.Vertex)
19     (at_vertex : (u : Space) = (v : Space)) : T.originalCurvature u = P.vertexCurvature v := by
20   classical
21   have equal (w : P.Vertex) : (w : Space) = (u : Space) ↔ w = v := by
22     rw [at_vertex]
23     exact Subtype.coe_inj
24   simp [originalCurvature, equal]
25 
26 theorem originalCurvature_at_nonvertex (u : T.vertices) (not_vertex : (u : Space) ∉ P.vertices) :
27     T.originalCurvature u = 0 := by
28   classical
29   apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
30   intro v _
31   apply if_neg
32   intro equal
33   exact not_vertex (equal ▸ v.property)
34 
35 /-- Summation loses precisely the source's curvature. -/
36 theorem sum_originalCurvature [Fintype T.vertices] (source : P.Vertex)
37     (at_source : (a : Space) = (source : Space)) :
38     (∑ u, T.originalCurvature u) = (∑ v : P.Vertex, P.vertexCurvature v) - P.vertexCurvature source := by
39   classical
40   have vertex_sum (v : P.Vertex) :
41       (∑ u : T.vertices, if (v : Space) = (u : Space) then P.vertexCurvature v else 0) =
42         if v = source then 0 else P.vertexCurvature v := by
43     by_cases same : v = source
44     · subst v
45       rw [if_pos rfl]
46       apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
47       intro u _
48       apply if_neg
49       intro equal
50       exact T.vertex_ne_source u (equal.symm.trans at_source.symm)
51     · rw [if_neg same]
52       have different : (v : Space) ≠ (a : Space) := by
53         intro equal
54         exact same (Subtype.ext (equal.trans at_source))
55       let w : T.vertices := ⟨v, T.original_vertex_mem v.property different⟩
56       have equal (u : T.vertices) : (v : Space) = (u : Space) ↔ u = w :=
57         ⟨fun h => Subtype.ext h.symm, fun h => by subst u; rfl⟩
58       simp only [equal]
59       simp
60   simp only [originalCurvature]
61   rw [Finset.sum_comm]
62   simp_rw [vertex_sum]
63   calc
64     _ = ∑ v : P.Vertex, (P.vertexCurvature v - if v = source then P.vertexCurvature source else 0) := by
65       apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
66       intro v _
67       split_ifs with same
68       · simp [same]
69       · simp
70     _ = _ := by rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]; simp
71 
72 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron.CutLocusTree
